name: Neelkanth Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, R.T. Exports Ltd is engaged in trading of agri products, mainly basmati rice
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company does export and local trading of agro products. It procures rice from various parts of country and exports it under brand  White Pearl. Company also has a warehouse facility in Bundi, which it leases to Food Corporation of India and some other clients.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.41% over last 3 years.
